items.text: Confirm **in writing** that the 12 February session is **2027**, and get the full Jan–May 2027 calendar
Create the Lagos portal account (aflagos.extranet-aec.com) to see the calendar
Book the week-1 tutor assessment (Tue/Wed, 30 min, "assessment, not teaching")
Open a separate fee account and bank **₦44,000/week**
Confirm the refund/transfer policy **before** paying
Confirm it is TCF **Canada** — not TCF Québec or tout public (IRCC rejects those)
Name on registration matches passport **exactly**
Verify with the centre: **re-marking of speaking/writing suspended** for sessions from 1 Sep 2026
Week 5: start the registration watch (Lagos portal + Port Harcourt calendar)
Week 9 (Mon 16 Nov): money decision — fee fund ≥ ₦400k and contract income landed? Else March/April sitting
Week 11: **register the day the 2027 calendar opens**
Install Anki + *5000 most frequently used French words v6.0*
Pick the **Canadian French audio** variant
**Never hide the article field** — *la chose*, not *chose*
Record the 2-minute week-1 baseline voice memo (Diagnostic page)
Bookmark French Today audio guide, Forvo, Coffee Break French S1
Create the error log (starts in earnest week 6)

groups.title: Materials (two books is the whole spend)

items.text: Grammaire Progressive du Français A2 (then B1) — check AF Lagos stock
Réussir le TCF Canada (Didier) — by week 13
Download the official TCF samples + Manuel du candidat — read before the first mock
**Gate 1 (12 Oct):** 3–5 min conversation without English · ~900 words · PC accurate in speech · pronunciation not fossilising · movement vs week-1 recording
**Gate 2 (16 Nov):** InnerFrench 1.0× with transcript · ~2,000 words · 120 words in 20 min · 3 min prepared speech
**Gate 3 (14 Dec):** CO ≥ 400 · CE ≥ 400 · 180-word piece ~9/20 · 3 min unprepared
**Gate 4 (11 Jan):** CO ≥ 458 · CE ≥ 453 timed · EE tâche 2 10/20 · EO tâche 3 sustained
**GO/DEFER (week 19):** full mock clears all four thresholds **with margin**
Rest Thursday 11 Feb
Passport + convocation packed
Warm-up: 10 question frames + 1-minute opinion

selfcheck: Did new material enter **Tuesday to Thursday** (not a post-call Monday)?
Did I **speak out loud** on at least four days?
Did **every** piece of writing come back **marked**?
Did Friday's spiral happen (not just this week's review)?
Is the error log growing — and did I read it on Sunday?
Anki: did the streak hold (no break of 3+ days)?
selfcheckRule: Any two of **2, 3 and 5** failing for two consecutive weeks is the same signal as a missed gate. Act then, not at the next checkpoint.
wellbeingRule: **Two of three failing:** cut micro1 to the 10-hour minimum and move the TCF to April. Pre-committed — no renegotiating in the moment.
